scope: Remove flower-in-palm homepage selection; curate existing set and add two source-based Poetic Natural watercolors. Local preview only.

rationale.palm: Intimate close-up and densely repeated florets dominate the homepage text; preserved for a future suitable story or poem.
rationale.tree: Traffic, people and street objects compete for attention; retained for future editorial context, no automatic reassignment.
rationale.water: Cool, open horizontal space offers a quieter mood than the warm field.
rationale.bridge: An ordinary human route introduces purposeful perspective rather than another plant detail.

diagnosis: The palm flower has near-uniform floret definition and a disproportionately large focal object.
The street scene gives many objects similar detail and visual weight at homepage size.
New water art should avoid evenly etched ripples and overly dramatic clouds.
New bridge art should avoid mechanically decorated rails, sharpened distant trees and exaggerated earth tones.
preservation: Existing originals, generated masters and assets retained. No poem-specific image reused for the homepage. Existing no-controls per-tab selection retained.
